environment.host: amax (shared GPU server, CPU only for this experiment)
environment.native: build-Release under the PR worktree; simulation fingerprint recorded by each run's pipeline.json contract

comparison.scope: Held-out maps, frozen final policy.pt per arm, one report per style. A pass here is a development signal at 65,536 PPO steps, not deployment evidence; per-case regressions are listed regardless of the overall verdict.

cases.map0-l1-argmax-balanced: gen_01007000 level 1 frozen_argmax vs balanced, seed 100001
cases.map1-l4-argmax-mobile: gen_01008000 level 4 frozen_argmax vs mobile, seed 200001

finding: The pre-registered comparison is null by construction at this recipe: with reference_coef=1 on a near-deterministic imitation init (entropy ~0.01), 65,536 PPO steps leave the argmax policy almost unchanged, so both arms play the imitation teacher. Removing the reference term lets PPO move the policy (entropy 0.01 -> 0.13) but the moved policy is worse on both probe cases; adding entropy bonus 0.05 collapses it to 0/32. Style rotation cannot be evaluated until the learner actually improves on its initialisation.
not_claimed: No statement about style rotation at larger budgets or other recipes; no real multi-wave games; no deployment.
